$comment: Per-figure capture recipes consumed by web/manual/capture-figures.mjs (npm run manual:figures). Every <figure data-figure="..."> declared in session-manager-operations/manual/chapters/*.html must have a matching entry here, keyed by that id, EXCEPT the figures listed in this script's own KNOWN_UNREACHABLE (see src/main/__tests__ / manual figure-coverage test) — those are surfaces the script genuinely cannot reach (a state it has no way to produce) and are deliberately left out rather than shipping a recipe known to fail. navKey is a CommandPalette 'nav:<key>' id (see src/renderer/components/CommandPalette.tsx). steps run in order before the screenshot; each callout selector is resolved to a live DOM bounding box at capture time — never a hardcoded pixel guess. Many selectors below are plain text=/class selectors rather than data-testid, because the underlying screens (Agent Library, Tag Library, MCP Servers, Hooks, Memory, Settings, Plugins, History, Home) carry zero data-testid attributes as of this writing — verified by grep, not assumed.
